method: Every source of the pack was retrieved again on the admission date with research/ai-money/tools.mjs fetch, into a copy of the pack outside the repository, and every quotation (records, events and document disclaimers) was matched again with tools.mjs verify: Unicode compatibility forms, quotation marks, dashes, PDF line-break hyphens and whitespace normalised, case folded; for Chinese passages whitespace dropped; fragments joined by an ellipsis matched in order. Web pages are served with new markup on each request, so their file hashes differ while the text matches.
